gloss: buying and eating food on the go

definitions.gloss: buying and eating snacks on the go; eating while walking
definitions.explanation: The act of buying food at shops or stalls and eating it on the spot or while walking. Often associated with children buying snacks on the way home from school.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{帰|かえ}りに{買|か}い{食|ぐ}いをした。
examples.english: I bought snacks on the way home from school.

examples.japanese: {買|か}い{食|ぐ}いは{禁止|きんし}されていた。
examples.english: Buying snacks on the way was forbidden.

examples.japanese: {商店街|しょうてんがい}で{買|か}い{食|ぐ}いしながら{散歩|さんぽ}するのが{楽|たの}しい。
examples.english: It's fun to stroll through the shopping street, buying and eating snacks as you go.

notes:
USAGE:
Traditionally associated with school children buying snacks from shops on their way home. Many schools in Japan have rules prohibiting {買|か}い{食|ぐ}い. In modern usage, it also describes adults enjoying street food at festivals, markets, or shopping streets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {買|か}い{食|ぐ}い{禁止|きんし} (prohibition on buying snacks)
- {食|た}べ{歩|ある}き / {買|か}い{食|ぐ}い (eating while walking / buying snacks)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食|た}べ{歩|ある}き: eating while walking — focuses on the walking aspect, more positive connotation
- つまみ{食|ぐ}い: snacking, nibbling — picking at food before it's served
